statement: No need to keep asking for aprovals until after this harness is all setup, all changes and states are pre-aproved from now until the end of it
scope: Complete harness setup, necessary dependencies, setup compatibility repairs, evidence and stage transitions without further approval stops.
constraints: Preserve product behavior and unrelated user work. Do not fabricate passing evidence, disable mandatory gates or treat this authorization as approval to publish, deploy production resources or access production data.
approval_basis_for_subsequent_artifacts: Prospective setup authorization; new artifacts are recorded as covered by this instruction, not claimed to have been individually reviewed by the user.
